rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for bringing trouble, criticism, or other unwanted consequences upon yourself.

example.english: If you keep being so rude in front of people, you'll incur a lot of criticism.
example.traditional: 你再喺人哋面前咁串，實會惹嚟一大堆批評。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 gam3 cyun3 sat6 wui5 je5 lai4 jat1 daai6 deoi1 pai1 ping4

rows.note: Use this specifically when what is incurred is a debt, bill, deficit, or other financial liability.

example.english: By shopping recklessly this month, I incur over a thousand dollars in credit-card debt.
example.traditional: 我今個月亂咁買嘢，欠落成千蚊卡數。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 lyun6 gam3 maai5 je5 him3 lok6 sing4 cin1 man1 kaat1 sou3

rows.note: Use this broader equivalent mainly in formal or written contexts for incurring an adverse result, penalty, or liability.

example.english: Breaching the contract terms may incur legal liability.
example.traditional: 違反合約條款，可能招致法律責任。
example.jyutping: wai4 faan2 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2 ho2 nang4 ziu1 zi3 faat3 leot6 zaak3 jam6
